nodes.label: Local Quality Gate (scripts/check.sh)
nodes.rationale: Runs cargo fmt --check, clippy with -D warnings across all targets/features, the workspace test suite, and cargo doc. On a Mac without the macFUSE SDK it uses fuser's compile-only macos-no-mount mode so the callback and binary API still receive static analysis.

nodes.label: Crate Change Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Wire types in crates/protocol (docs/protocol.md updated with every protocol change), quinn/rustls in crates/transport-quic, filesystem policy and export-root confinement in crates/server-core, platform-independent client behavior in crates/client-core, macOS bindings under clients/macos. thiserror in libraries, anyhow only at binary entry points, and #![forbid(unsafe_code)] preserved unless a platform binding makes narrowly isolated unsafe unavoidable.
